product_points: Black Fox offers Windows VPN Installer (ops toolkit) and Android companion apps.
Working modes are Basic, Pro, and AI Pro (three modes; not the old two-mode marketing).
Basic free ops: Setup Central, Connect SSH, Full Deploy.
Pro and AI Pro are different licenses — Pro ≠ AI Pro.
Never invent prices. Share purchase/contact links only when the user asks.
